title: bug: missing save button in treatment profile editor
symptom: In the treatment profile editor, the save button is only visible after splitting or deleting a block. When a user changes a value and minimizes the keyboard instead of using the check button on the keyboard, the save button does not appear.
cause: The behavior is by design: minimizing the keyboard is equivalent to cancelling any edits made to the item being edited, whereas tapping the checkmark confirms the edit and makes the save button appear.
fix: No code change was made. The workaround is to tap the checkmark button on the keyboard after editing a value to confirm the edit, which makes the save button appear. Alternatively, if the keyboard is minimized, tap beside the value again to reopen the keyboard and then use the checkmark.
evidence_quote: Minimizing a keyboard, currently, is not equivalent to having tapped on the checkmark. It is equivalent to having changed your mind about editing the item you were on.
